root_idea.summary: The root centers on restraint and prevention: fetters hold back, while deterrent punishment prevents recurrence and warns others.
root_idea.development: The semantic development runs from physical restraining implements such as fetters and bridle-irons to making a person or peer recoil, and then to deterrent punishment or chastisement.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic plural أَنْكَالٌ is presented under the attested singular citation form نِكْلٌ.
The form is a distinct Quranic noun denoting deterrent or exemplary punishment.
The form is a distinct Quranic verbal noun denoting the infliction of deterrent chastisement.

senses.definition: A fetter or shackle; the Quranic plural أَنْكَالٌ denotes restraining bonds.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic occurrence is plural and refers to shackles prepared as punishment.

senses.definition: A deterrent or exemplary punishment, intended to prevent recurrence by the offender and to warn others.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for punishment regarded as a warning or restraint, not merely as retribution without a deterrent function.

senses.definition: The infliction of deterrent punishment or chastisement—doing to someone what deters him and others from repeating the offense.
senses.usage_conditions: Verbal-noun form of نَكَّلَ به; the Quranic use concerns punitive chastisement as a deterrent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be weak or unable to undertake something; to shrink or recoil from it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with عن for withdrawing from or failing to undertake a matter.
A transitive use for physically restraining an object or creature.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An iron bit of a bridle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete restraining implement associated with the bridle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A formidable person or thing that overawes or overcomes its peers.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A lexical use for something that makes its equals recoil or unable to match it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A strong, experienced man mounted on a strong, experienced horse.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional expression describing matched strength and experience in rider and mount.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that chastises or deters a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An object or means whose effect makes a person recoil or prevents repetition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Something that chastises or punishes a person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used in the expression رماه الله بنُكْلِه وبنُكْلَةٍ, meaning that someone was struck with what chastises him.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only cross-reference; the unit supplies no lexical definition.
The unit defines النكل as what makes its peers recoil.
The unit defines نكالٌ as deterrent punishment.

cautions: The Quranic plural أَنْكَالٌ is normalized under the singular dictionary headword نِكْلٌ.
تَنْكِيلٌ is labeled as a verbal noun despite its generic Noun tag in the supplied QAC morphology.
The strong rider and horse usage is an idiomatic Classical Arabic expression, not a separate Quranic sense.
